The '''J8LF fusial thrust engine''' was a model of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek Inc.]]. The [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]] was equipped with one such engine beneath each of its [[S-foils/Legends|s-foils]] .<ref name="Stay on Target" />
